stem:
Which situation can be represented by this inequality?

120 \u2264 12k + 29

options.label: A
options.text: Felicia has 12 buttons in her collection. She will collect 29 new buttons every year. Felicia collects buttons for k years. For what values of k will Felicia have at least 120 buttons?

options.label: B
options.text: Felicia has 29 buttons in her collection. She will collect 12 new buttons every year. Felicia collects buttons for k years. For what values of k will Felicia have at least 120 buttons?

options.label: C
options.text: Felicia has 29 buttons in her collection. She will collect 12 new buttons every year. Felicia collects buttons for k years. For what values of k will Felicia have at most 120 buttons?

options.label: D
options.text: Felicia has 12 buttons in her collection. She will collect 29 new buttons every year. Felicia collects buttons for k years. For what values of k will Felicia have at most 120 buttons?
